info.title: STDU_SHOP Public Inquiry and Staff Workflow API
info.description: FROZEN R1-010 Contract Amendment 01, refined by the owner-approved one-way revocation rule. Inquiry submission has no public read/status endpoint; attachment upload routes resolve the Inquiry only from the header capability.

post.description: Creates Inquiry + submitted lines + audit in one PostgreSQL transaction. Returns 201 only after commit. publicReference is a receipt, not a credential; there is no public inquiry lookup. When attachments are planned, client may include a CSPRNG-generated 256-bit uploadCapability in this JSON body; only its SHA-256 is stored and it grants attachment upload only. Later intent/upload/cancel calls carry it in X-Inquiry-Upload-Capability.

200.description: Permission-scoped keyset page; no contact PII in list rows
Contact snapshot is omitted unless inquiries.contacts.read is also effective

ETag.description: Inquiry version, used with If-Match on aggregate mutations

200.description: Allowlisted audit timeline, no raw request or PII

patch.summary: Assign or replace the inquiry manager

200.description: Assignment receipt and new aggregate version

put.summary: Set or clear the due date for the current stage
put.description: Human-managed internal due date, distinct from customer desiredDeadline. Uses current inquiry scope, transition permission, If-Match and durable idempotency. No automatic SLA calculation or notification is performed. A successful status transition clears this value.

200.description: Stage due date committed with audit and new aggregate version

post.description: The ordinary staff transition branch excludes QUOTE_SENT and CLOSED. A separate strict union branch permits pre-quote closure to CLOSED only from the five eligible states and with one of the five enumerated reasonCode values; it uses this same permission, If-Match, durable idempotency and transactional audit boundary. If an upload capability remains active, this trusted staff operation revokes it in the same locked transaction by clearing its stored hash and expiry together; only the changed field names are recorded in the close AuditEvent. A RECEIVING upload rechecks that the hash remains present before finalization, so a concurrent revocation cannot consume its intent or create a document. QUOTE_SENT remains exclusively owned by approved quote delivery; a QUOTE_SENT inquiry may close only through its later quote lifecycle.

200.description: Transition committed with audit and new version
Internal-only comments; never included in public DTO

get.summary: Read attachment metadata and security state

200.description: No storage keys or public URLs
Authorized private stream; attachment disposition, no-store, nosniff, no public URL

409.description: Document not CLEAN; body uses Error envelope

post.summary: Reserve a one-use upload for one inquiry
post.description: Requires the upload-only capability supplied with createPublicInquiry. The server resolves the bound Inquiry from the capability hash; no Inquiry UUID or public lookup is needed. Capability grants attachment upload only.

put.summary: Upload the bytes for one reserved intent
put.description: Streams bytes into a private temporary object; the server resolves Inquiry from the upload capability and verifies the intent is bound to it. The route contains no Inquiry UUID. The stream must start before the 30-minute intent expiry and finish within the receiving deadline captured from the Inquiry server-selected profile (15 minutes MVP_SAFE; 60 minutes ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTS). Expiry does not interrupt a RECEIVING stream, but its captured deadline does. Enforces selected profile limits while streaming with bounded backpressure, sniffs the allowlisted type and computes SHA-256, then commits one immutable QUARANTINED source document, intent consumption, idempotency receipt and audit. A failed upload never rolls back the Inquiry. Partial bytes are deleted or ownership-checked as a private orphan. Retry after a completed same-key request replays the safe receipt after current capability/intent authorization; a consumed intent cannot be used with a new key.

delete.description: Only the bound upload capability can cancel an ISSUED intent. The server resolves Inquiry from the capability hash and verifies the intent belongs to it; no Inquiry UUID is present in the route. It cannot delete an Inquiry or completed source document. Retry requires a new intent.

StaffSessionCookie.name: __Host-stdu_staff
StaffSessionCookie.description: Existing FROZEN R1-002 staff session; explicit loopback development profile follows that contract.

InquiryUploadCapability.name: X-Inquiry-Upload-Capability
InquiryUploadCapability.description: Client-generated 256-bit CSPRNG capability; server stores SHA-256 only. Bound to one Inquiry; attachment-only; never grants read/status/download access.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unpredictable unique key. Recommended 128-bit or more CSPRNG entropy. Stored only as SHA-256.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly match configured public web origin; arbitrary X-Forwarded-For and reflected CORS are rejected.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong inquiry aggregate version ETag from current staff detail.

StaffCsrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
StaffCsrf.description: Existing FROZEN R1-002 staff CSRF token for unsafe cookie-authenticated operations.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque permission-scoped keyset cursor; not an authorization credential.

preferredChannel.description: Must correspond to a supplied non-null email/phone channel.

desiredDeadline.description: Optional customer-entered deadline wording preserved verbatim; not parsed into an SLA or stage due date.

customerComment.description: Optional customer-entered note; immutable, private contact snapshot data.

quantity.description: Positive decimal string with dot or comma as the optional decimal separator; no grouping separator. Preserved literally and never converted through binary floating point.

catalogProductSlugContext.description: Untrusted context only; never matched, linked or used as authority.

expectedDeliverables.description: Optional expected outcomes, preserved as customer wording.

catalogProductContext.description: Optional untrusted product-card URL hint from the request form. Preserve as context only; never resolve it to a product, link a record, authorize access, match an SKU, or use it in a quote.

uploadCapability.description: Optional base64url 256-bit CSPRNG value required only when attachments are requested. Never echoed or logged.

privacyNotice.description: Exact content and whether required are BLOCKED on OD-010-02; no production collection before legal approval.

sizeBytes.description: Schema hard ceiling is 50 MiB. The server enforces the smaller limit from the immutable server-selected Inquiry upload profile: 10 MiB/file for MVP_SAFE or 50 MiB/file for ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTS.

maxBytes.description: Maximum accepted stream size for this intent at reservation: the minimum of its immutable declared size, the immutable server-selected profile per-file limit, remaining Inquiry byte quota and remaining source/UTC-day byte quota. The client cannot select or raise the profile; the server enforces this ceiling while streaming and requires the received size to equal the declared size.

stageDueAt.description: Staff-managed due date for this current stage; not the customer's desiredDeadline.

catalogProductContext.description: Untrusted context copied from the catalog CTA; informational only and never a product link or authorization fact.

stageDueAt.description: Set an explicit due date for the current stage or null to clear it. No automatic value is inferred.

StaffTransitionTargetStatus.description: Ordinary staff transitions cannot set NEW, QUOTE_SENT or CLOSED; pre-quote CLOSED is a distinct strict TransitionRequest branch with a required closure reason.

TransitionRequest.description: Disjoint strict request variants. CLOSED is accepted only by CloseInquiryWithoutQuoteRequest and only from a pre-quote state.

CloseInquiryWithoutQuoteRequest.description: This request is accepted only while the locked Inquiry is NEW, TRIAGE, NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, ENGINEERING_REVIEW or READY_FOR_QUOTE. CLOSED is terminal; QUOTE_SENT is excluded.

Conflict.description: OCC, invalid state, used upload intent or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; no partial domain mutation

TooLarge.description: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE; stream stopped at configured hard bound

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED; safe retry hint, no source address detail

Unavailable.description: Dependency unavailable; fail closed for public writes

Unauthorized.description: UNAUTHORIZED; no details that distinguish missing from invalid capability

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND; does not reveal whether another inquiry or intent exists

x-upload-profile-contract.profileSelection: server-only and persisted per Inquiry; clients cannot select a profile

x-permission-rules.downloadStaffInquiryDocument: (inquiries.read_assigned OR inquiries.read_all) AND inquiries.documents.read AND inquiries.documents.download

x-invariants: No public DTO exposes staff IDs, internal comments, contact snapshots, storage keys or inquiry status.
No public content is trusted for SKU matching, BOM, substitute or quote computation.
Every mutation uses durable Idempotency-Key; staff state/assignment mutations use If-Match.

Before replaying any staff mutation receipt, revalidate current session, CSRF/Origin, action permission and inquiry read scope; before public upload replay, revalidate live capability and intent binding.

Ordinary staff transition requests cannot set QUOTE_SENT or CLOSED; the strict pre-quote close variant permits CLOSED only from NEW, TRIAGE, NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, ENGINEERING_REVIEW or READY_FOR_QUOTE with a mandatory enumerated reason. QUOTE_SENT-to-CLOSED remains only a later quote-lifecycle integration.
Assignments cannot be cleared; setInquiryStageDeadline manages optional human-set current-stage due dates without SLA automation.
Staff unsafe requests follow FROZEN R1-002 cookie, exact Origin and CSRF rules.
Every public write validates exact configured Origin; no credentialed wildcard CORS.
No source file download unless CLEAN and both document permissions plus inquiry scope pass.
No external parser, malware result is never assumed, no automatic notification provider.

Public inquiry create JSON is limited to 2 MiB and at most 50 equipment lines; file bytes use the immutable server-selected profile in x-upload-profile-contract and are streamed with backpressure rather than buffered as whole bodies.

The per-source/UTC-day byte budget charges declared upload-intent bytes exactly once at accepted intent creation across all Inquiries for the HMAC source fingerprint. The atomic Redis bucket never resets, refunds or widens during that UTC day; when profile caps differ, the effective cap is the lowest cap seen for that source/day.
An optional catalogProductContext is preserved only as untrusted inquiry context; it never links, resolves, matches or authorizes a catalog product.
